# Sourcey

## Documentation

- [Introduction](https://sourcey.com/docs/introduction.md): Sourcey tells the whole product story. Specs, code, rich guides, changelog, roadmap pages, examples, and portable context files from your project as static HTML.
- [Install](https://sourcey.com/docs/install.md): Every supported install path for Sourcey. npm, Homebrew, Docker, and Nix for the main CLI. Go, Homebrew, and Scoop for the standalone Go docs generator.
- [Quick Start](https://sourcey.com/docs/quickstart.md): From zero to a running docs site in under a minute.
- [Project Structure](https://sourcey.com/docs/project-structure.md): How sourcey finds your config, markdown files, and OpenAPI specs.
- [Writing Pages](https://sourcey.com/docs/writing-pages.md): Markdown files with frontmatter. Title, description, and content.
- [Components](https://sourcey.com/docs/components.md): Rich components in plain markdown. No JSX, no imports, just directives.
- [OpenAPI Integration](https://sourcey.com/docs/openapi-integration.md): Point sourcey at a spec. Get a complete API reference with code samples.
- [MCP Integration](https://sourcey.com/docs/mcp-integration.md): Document MCP servers with tools, resources, and prompts rendered as browsable reference docs.
- [Rustdoc Integration](https://sourcey.com/docs/rustdoc-integration.md): Document Rust crates from rustdoc JSON, with doctests extracted as a first-class view.
- [MkDocs Integration](https://sourcey.com/docs/mkdocs-integration.md): Point a tab at mkdocs.yml. Sourcey imports the nav, pages, and assets of an existing MkDocs site.
- [Themes & Layout](https://sourcey.com/docs/themes-and-layout.md): Four themes, custom colors, fonts, layout dimensions, and CSS overrides.
- [Dark Mode](https://sourcey.com/docs/dark-mode.md): Built in. localStorage persistence. Light and dark logo variants.
- [Search](https://sourcey.com/docs/search.md): Client-side fuzzy search. Cmd+K. Works offline.
- [Documentation for agents](https://sourcey.com/docs/context-exports.md): Publish readable Markdown, API contracts and discovery files from the same sources as your website.
- [Deploying](https://sourcey.com/docs/deploying.md): Static HTML. Deploy to GitHub Pages, Vercel, Netlify, S3, or anywhere.
- [Changelog](https://sourcey.com/docs/changelog.md): All notable changes to Sourcey. Format based on Keep a Changelog.

## Guides

- [Your First Docs Site](https://sourcey.com/docs/guides/guide-first-docs-site.md): Build a complete documentation site from scratch. API reference plus markdown guides.
- [Custom Branding](https://sourcey.com/docs/guides/guide-custom-branding.md): Your colors, your fonts, your logo. Make it yours.
- [Multi-Tab Sites](https://sourcey.com/docs/guides/guide-multi-tab-sites.md): Combine markdown guides, API reference, and more in a single site.
- [Tutorial: Document Your MCP Server](https://sourcey.com/docs/guides/guide-mcp-docs.md): Generate browsable documentation from an MCP server in five minutes.
- [Go / godoc Docs](https://sourcey.com/docs/guides/guide-godoc-go.md): Generate Go API reference from package comments, exported symbols, and examples.
- [Doxygen / C++ Docs](https://sourcey.com/docs/guides/guide-doxygen-cpp.md): Generate API reference from Doxygen XML output.
- [Embedding in Existing Sites](https://sourcey.com/docs/guides/guide-embedding.md): Add sourcey docs as a subfolder in your existing website.
- [Build Ask AI with Sourcey and LangChain](https://sourcey.com/docs/guides/guide-langchain-retriever.md): Implement your own Ask AI feature over a Sourcey docs site.
- [Generating mcp.json](https://sourcey.com/docs/guides/mcp-snapshot.md): Snapshot a running MCP server or write the spec by hand.
- [MCP Ecosystem](https://sourcey.com/docs/guides/mcp-ecosystem.md): mcp-schema and mcp-parser, TypeScript tooling for MCP server specifications.

## Configuration

- [sourcey.config.ts](https://sourcey.com/docs/config/ref-config.md): Full configuration reference. Every option, every type.
- [Theme Tokens](https://sourcey.com/docs/config/ref-theme-tokens.md): Colors, fonts, layout dimensions, and CSS overrides.
- [Navigation](https://sourcey.com/docs/config/ref-navigation.md): Tabs, groups, pages, and slugs.
- [Navbar & Footer](https://sourcey.com/docs/config/ref-navbar-footer.md): Links, social icons, and CTA buttons.
- [Code Samples](https://sourcey.com/docs/config/ref-code-samples.md): Auto-generated code samples for API endpoints.

## CLI

- [sourcey dev](https://sourcey.com/docs/cli/cli-dev.md): Start a Vite dev server with SSR hot reload.
- [sourcey build](https://sourcey.com/docs/cli/cli-build.md): Build static HTML documentation.
- [sourcey validate](https://sourcey.com/docs/cli/cli-validate.md): Validate an OpenAPI spec without building.
- [sourcey godoc](https://sourcey.com/docs/cli/cli-godoc.md): Snapshot a Go module's documentation into a portable JSON file.
